data.description: Luxury Low-Rise Living | 1 Bedroom | District One
data.display_address: Residence 25, District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience luxury living in this spacious 1-bedroom apartment located in Residences 25, District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid City. This well-designed unit offers a perfect balance of comfort, elegance, and functionality, ideal for singles or couples seeking an upscale lifestyle in one of the Dubai's most prestigious communities. 

Property Details:
* 1 Bedroom
* 2 Toilets 
* Size: 832.48 sq.ft
* Covered Parking
* Full access to the community pool
* Premium Community Amenities
* Prime Location in MBR City
* Fully Furnished

Residents of Residences 25 enjoy access to world-class amenities including swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, landscaped gardens, and dedicated covered parking. The community is known for its serene environment, low-rise buildings, and exclusive lifestyle, surrounded by greenery and the iconic Crystal Lagoon.

Located in District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, the property offers excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and major road networks such as Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road. Residents benefit from proximity to top schools, retail outlets, dining options, and leisure attractions, while enjoying a peaceful and secure gated community.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
